title: A target enrichment method for gathering phylogenetic information from hundreds of loci: an example from the Compositae
main_capability: Family-specific nuclear target enrichment in Asteraceae
critical_result_or_feature: Recovered phylogenetically informative sequence from 763 conserved orthologous loci across 15 Compositae exemplars
EAzami_use: Foundation for the Compositae1061-compatible East Asian species backbone
known_risk_or_limit: Original pilot predates the expanded 1061-locus panel and does not solve paralogy/polyploidy automatically

title: HybPiper: Extracting coding sequence and introns for phylogenetics from high-throughput sequencing reads using target enrichment
main_capability: Map assemble and extract target loci plus introns and flag paralogs
critical_result_or_feature: Produces locus sequences and paralog warnings from target-enrichment reads
EAzami_use: Primary reproducible raw-read-to-locus workflow for new and public Compositae1061 data
known_risk_or_limit: One selected sequence per locus can hide homeologs unless paralog outputs are explicitly retained

title: HybPhyloMaker: Target enrichment data analysis from raw reads to species trees
critical_result_or_feature: Links read processing alignments gene trees and species-tree reconstruction
EAzami_use: Useful benchmark and alternative reproducible pipeline for cross-checking the backbone
known_risk_or_limit: External software stack and pipeline assumptions require version freezing

title: ASTRAL: genome-scale coalescent-based species tree estimation
main_capability: Species-tree inference from gene trees under the multispecies coalescent
critical_result_or_feature: Separates high gene-tree discordance from one concatenated history
known_risk_or_limit: Does not model introgression and is sensitive to poor gene-tree estimation

title: PhyloNetworks: A package for phylogenetic networks
main_capability: Network inference and visualization with SNaQ plus comparative methods
critical_result_or_feature: Estimates hybrid edges from gene-tree quartet information with bootstrap support
EAzami_use: Test reticulate alternatives in Taiwanese and young East Asian radiations
known_risk_or_limit: Network search can be unstable with weak gene trees too few taxa or excessive hybrid nodes

title: Lineage-specific vs. universal: A comparison of the Compositae1061 and Angiosperms353 enrichment panels in the sunflower family
main_capability: Empirical comparison and data-merging test for two target-capture panels
critical_result_or_feature: Compositae1061 recovered about 721 loci on average but 9-46 percent were flagged as paralogous; Angiosperms353 recovered about 287 loci; 30 loci were shared
EAzami_use: Supports Compositae1061 for maximum continuity while retaining a documented bridge to existing Angiosperms353 samples
known_risk_or_limit: Higher locus yield comes with substantial paralogy and only limited direct overlap between panels

title: HybPhaser: a workflow for the detection and phasing of hybrids in target capture data sets
main_capability: Detect and phase hybrid alleles from target-capture reads
critical_result_or_feature: Uses allele similarity and phylogenetic placement to identify hybrid samples and parental contributions
EAzami_use: Screen East Asian focal taxa for hybrid ancestry before ancestral-state inference
known_risk_or_limit: Performance depends on parental reference sampling and sufficient divergent alleles

title: A new pipeline for removing paralogs in target enrichment data
main_capability: Putative paralog detection using sequence similarity and heterozygous-site thresholds
critical_result_or_feature: Adds explicit paralog screening to HybPiper-derived target-enrichment data
EAzami_use: Generate conservative single-copy matrices alongside paralog-aware analyses
known_risk_or_limit: Threshold choices can discard true alleles/homeologs and must be sensitivity-tested

title: ASTRAL-Pro 2: ultrafast species tree reconstruction from multi-copy gene family trees
main_capability: Species-tree inference from multi-copy gene-family trees
critical_result_or_feature: Retains multi-copy information instead of requiring all loci to be reduced to one copy
EAzami_use: Key sensitivity for polyploid and duplicated East Asian Cirsium loci
known_risk_or_limit: Still estimates a tree rather than a reticulate network and depends on correct copy tagging
